overall: The AG found the committee violated the Open Meeting Law by posting an August 12 meeting notice with no listing of anticipated topics, and by failing to respond to the complaint within the legal timeframe; ordered compliance and training certification.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the committee held an August 12 meeting without listing anticipated discussion topics on the posted notice.
allegations.key_passage: Here, the August 12 meeting notice did not include a listing of topics to be discussed at the meeting.

allegations.summary: Not raised in the complaint: the committee did not respond to the complaint within the 14 business days required by law, responding only after the AG contacted it.
allegations.key_passage: This failure to respond to an Open Meeting Law complaint within the time frame required by law also violated the Open Meeting Law.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law, with a caution that similar future violations may be considered evidence of intent to violate the law.
Review the AG's Open Meeting Law Training Video #2: Meeting Notices and certify to the AG's office within 30 days of the letter, using the attached form.
remedy_passage: We order immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law, and we caution that similar future violations may be considered evidence of intent to violate the law. Additionally, we order the Committee to review the Attorney General's Open Meeting Law Training Video #2: Meeting Notices and certify to our office within thirty (30) days of this letter, using the attached form, that it has done so.
note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
